h1: MVP testing and fixes before you launch
overview: Before you invite customers, we use your product the way a stranger would. We follow your main flows on phones and laptops, write down every bug and confusing step, and rank them by how much they hurt. Then we fix the important ones inside your code, retest and send you a clear report. You see what was found, what we changed and what is worth doing next.

faq: Do you fix the bugs or only list them?
Both, within the limit in your package. We fix what is quick and safe, and list anything larger with an estimate so you can choose. Nothing is changed in your live product without your approval.
How do you find users for the sessions?
You bring them, such as early signups or friends in your target group. We write the tasks, run the calls, and ask for permission before recording. We do not use bots or paid fake testers.
Is this the same as a security audit?
No. Premium includes a basic check of login, forms and access rules for common mistakes. A full penetration test is a specialist job we do not offer, and we say so in the report.
What access do you need to test?
A staging or live link, one test account for each user role and, if you want fixes, access to your code repository. Please do not share real customer logins or passwords with us.
